goal: Put the hammer, pliers, tape measure and wrench each into its matching slot inside the toolbox (with the right orientation), then return the arm(s) to the start pose.
instruction_templates: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
success: pliers: the pliers' ACTIVE functional point 'center' OR its 'center_flip' point is within 0.05 m (3D, strictly less; default threshold) of the toolbox's passive functional point 'pliers_slot' AND the orientation of those two point frames differs by less than 10 degrees (is_align_qpos=True, default align_qpos_threshold=10 deg). Either the normal or the flipped (180-degree symmetric) pose is accepted.
hammer: active functional point 'center' within 0.05 m of the toolbox passive point 'hammer_slot' and orientation within 10 degrees of the slot frame.
tape_measure: active point 'center' within 0.05 m of the toolbox passive point 'tape_measure_slot' and orientation within 10 degrees.
wrench: active point 'center' within 0.05 m of the toolbox passive point 'wrench_slot' and orientation within 10 degrees.

For each of hammer, tape_measure, wrench and pliers (is_A_cover_B with A=toolbox, B=tool): the tool's oriented-bbox footprint polygon (XY) is entirely contained in the toolbox's footprint polygon AND tool bbox z_max < toolbox bbox z_max AND tool bbox z_min > toolbox bbox z_min - 0.03 m. (The tool must be inside the box's footprint and not above its top.)

all_robot_back_to_origin: every target arm's end-effector pose is within 0.15 m per axis (|dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m) and within 20 degrees (quaternion angular distance) of its start-of-episode pose (the arms must be returned to roughly their starting pose).
evaluation: Success conditions form ONE stage: after every action (once all simulation sub-steps of that action are done) the reward manager evaluates all conditions; the episode succeeds as soon as ALL hold simultaneously at the same moment (reward 1 -> episode ends with success). Conditions are not latched or ordered. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim=900 actions (the check made after the last action still counts). No early-fail rule exists apart from the environment being flagged invalid (e.g. a required label missing / physics broken).
objects: toolbox: static geometry (category 'toolbox', index 0), 1 total, at x in [-0.05,0.05], y in [-0.12,0.0], z=0.025 (Table-relative), fixed orientation quaternion [0.707,0,0,-0.707] (w,x,y,z)
hammer: rigid (hammer index 5), 1 total, left side of table x in [-0.4,-0.2], y in [-0.15,0.0], no rotation randomisation
wrench: rigid (wrench index 0), 1 total, left side x in [-0.4,-0.2], y in [-0.15,0.0]
pliers: rigid (pliers index 0), 1 total, right side x in [0.2,0.4], y in [-0.15,0.0]
tape_measure: rigid (tape_measure index 0), 1 total, right side x in [0.2,0.4], y in [-0.15,0.0]
needs_memory_or_language: none (each tool has its own named slot; matching is by label/slot name, which the solver must infer by shape/geometry of the slots)
end_requirements: All target (controlled) arms must be back near their start pose when success is evaluated (it is one of the success conditions, see success list): every target arm's end-effector position within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode (pose recorded right after the robot is set to its initial state). Gripper opening is NOT checked by the success test.
notes: All four tools must be in place at the same moment (all conditions in one stage). Orientation tolerance (10 deg) is strict and applies to the full 3D frame of the tool's functional point relative to the slot; pliers get a flipped alternative. The toolbox is static (does not move). Slot locations are asset metadata and cannot be determined from the source. Tool start positions on the table are independent random draws; hammer/wrench share a region and pliers/tape_measure share a region (collision avoidance by the layout sampler). No gripper-open requirement in success. The process score is 'transition' mode: 25/50/75/100 for 1/2/3/4 tools correctly in slot (functional-point+cover checks) with gripper open >=0.8 normalised, but does not decide success. Success is evaluated on object root poses/points, not on gripper contact. Object geometry sizes/asset dimensions are not in the source and cannot be determined statically.
